title: One core migration: remove the schema-1 upgrade path
question: The second core migration 2026_10_09_000000_upgrade_azguard_storage_to_schema_2 and StorageSchema::upgrade() exist only to upgrade schema-1 databases of 0.7.0. Keep or remove them?

options.text: Remove the upgrade path: one core migration 2026_10_01_000000_create_azguard_storage (create() already builds schema 2); delete the upgrade migration, StorageSchema::upgrade() and the schema-1 hint; a storage with another version stays StorageMismatchException.
Keep both frozen basenames; upgrade() stays a no-op on schema 2.

context: P3 design session 2026-10-13; owner M15/M16. Storage::SCHEMA_VERSION stays 2 (the stored storage_state value is unchanged).
decision: A — Remove the upgrade path: one core migration 2026_10_01_000000_create_azguard_storage (create() already builds schema 2); delete the upgrade migration, StorageSchema::upgrade() and the schema-1 hint; a storage with another version stays StorageMismatchException.
consequences: knowledge/identities#resources: the migration 2026_10_09_000000_upgrade_azguard_storage_to_schema_2 is removed; tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/Formats/resources.json is regenerated deliberately.
Tests that build a schema-1 storage (SubjectRevisionsTest upgrade cases, schema1 scenarios) are removed; tests for mismatched versions remain.
docs/advanced/operations.md loses the schema-1 upgrade text.
